short_blurb: Licensed Class B builder serving Beverly Hills — remodels, ADUs & more.
local_note: Beverly Hills homeowners choose Palm Crest Builders for kitchen and bath remodels, room additions, ADUs, and whole-home renovations. We know the local building department, design for Beverly Hills's mix of housing styles, and manage design, permits, and construction with our own licensed crews. We build throughout Beverly Hills, including Beverly Hills Flats, Beverly Hills Post Office (BHPO), Trousdale Estates. Every project is built to the California Building Code and backed by our workmanship warranty.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Beverly Hills?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the Beverly Hills building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in Beverly Hills?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Beverly Hills rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my Beverly Hills remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
